lab-en.say: Did my ferritin change since the last report for Test Person A?
lab-en.spoken: Your Ferritin went from 0.5 ng/mL on 3 September 2026 to 50 ng/mL on 12 October 2026. That's higher than before. It's now inside the lab's range. The 12 October 2026 result was corrected from 5 to 50, and I'm using the corrected value. Some general background: Ferritin shows how much iron your body has stored. Your doctor can read it alongside how you feel, your medicines and your other results.

lab-hi.say: टेस्ट पर्सन A का फेरिटिन पिछली रिपोर्ट से बदला क्या?

lab-hinglish.say: Test Person A ka ferritin pichhli report se badla kya?
lab-hinglish.spoken: Aapka Ferritin 3 September 2026 ko 0.5 ng/mL tha aur 12 October 2026 ko 50 ng/mL hai. Yeh pehle se zyada hai. Ab yeh lab ki range ke andar hai. 12 October 2026 ka result 5 se sudhaar kar 50 kiya gaya tha, aur main sudhra hua result use kar raha hoon. Thodi general jaankari: Ferritin se pata chalta hai ki body mein kitna iron store hai. Aapke doctor ise aapki tabiyat, dawaiyon aur baaki tests ke saath dekhkar sahi matlab samjha sakte hain.
